nodes.description: address public governance; used as the privileged owner account for minting rights administration
mapping(address => bool) public minters; whitelist controlling who may mint new tokens
private uint _totalSupply; total token supply tracked by ERC20
mapping(address => uint) private _balances; per-account token balances
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) private _allowances; ERC20 approval table
uint256 private TokenmaxSupply = 7000*10**18; hard cap on minted supply
constructor of DEFIBANK that initializes name/symbol/decimals and sets governance
public mint(address account, uint256 amount); restricted to whitelisted minters and capped by maxSupply
external burn(uint256 amount); destroys tokens from msg.sender balance
public setGovernance(address _governance); only current governance may transfer ownership
public addMinter(address _minter); governance-only addition to the minter whitelist
public removeMinter(address _minter); governance-only removal from the minter whitelist
internal _mint(address account, uint amount); increases _totalSupply and recipient balance
internal _burn(address account, uint amount); decreases account balance and _totalSupply
internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint amount); moves balances
public transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount); spends allowance and transfers tokens
public transfer(address recipient, uint amount); sends tokens from the caller
public approve(address spender, uint amount); sets allowance for caller
public view maxSupply(); returns the TokenmaxSupply cap
public view totalSupply(); returns _totalSupply
private SafeERC20 helper performing a low-level call on an arbitrary token address
internal safeTransferFrom(IERC20 token, address from, address to, uint value); encodes selector and delegates to callOptionalReturn
internal view _msgSender(); returns msg.sender as address payable
caller-controlled address used for authorization and balance operations
transaction origin used as the initial privileged governance account
governance = tx.origin; privileged ownership derived from an untrusted, phishable origin
totalSupply() + amount <= maxSupply(); unchecked uint256 addition evaluated before minting
address(token).call(data); arbitrary external low-level call made inside callOptionalReturn

bool success returned by the low-level external call in callOptionalReturn()
